name: Zodiac Series - Horse 1st Local Self-adhesive Booklet (10 stamps per booklet) (CSA26SBN)
page_name: Zodiac Series - Horse 1st Local Self-adhesive Booklet (10 stamps per booklet) (CSA26SBN)
description:
The Chinese calendar is based on five cycles of 12 years each, with each cycle tempered by one of the five Chinese elements – Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth. Each year features one of the 12 animal signs, and the year of 2026 is that of the Fire Horse.


The year 2026 marks the reign of the Horse and the seventh animal in the Zodiac series on the Chinese calendar. This energetic, driven and adventurous Horse is depicted on this set of stamps (1st Local and $2.00).
